citations.S1: SQL injection — critical.** `query = "... user_id = '%s' AND status = '%s'" % (user_id, status)` interpolates two request-controlled strings straight into SQL
citations.S2: Connection leaked on every call — high.** `conn` is never closed and there is no `try/finally`
citations.S3: `format_receipt` always raises `TypeError` — high.** `"Order #" + order[0]` concatenates `str` and `int`
citations.S4: `average_order_value` raises `ZeroDivisionError` on an empty list — high
citations.S5: Money held in binary floats — high, data integrity.** `total = 0.0`, `total += o[1]`, and `amount * pct / 100` all use floats
citations.S6: `apply_discount` accepts any `pct` — high.** `pct = -50` raises the price by 50%; `pct = 150` returns a negative amount
citations.S7: `status` is not validated against an allowlist — medium.** Any string reaches the query.
citations.S8: Missing authorization (IDOR) — critical.** `user_id` arrives from the request and is used verbatim as the ownership filter
citations.S9: A NULL `amount` crashes with an opaque `TypeError` — medium.** `total += o[1]` on `None`
citations.S10: `str(order[1])` renders money wrong — medium.** Produces `$12.5` or `$12.340000000000001`, never `$12.50`
citations.S11: Raw `sqlite3.Error` escapes to the HTTP handler — medium.** The exception text can carry the database file path and SQL fragments into a 500 page.
citations.S12: No rounding policy on the discount — medium.** `amount - amount * pct / 100` on 1999 cents at 15% gives 1699.15 — a fraction of a cent
citations.S13: Unbounded `fetchall()` — medium.** A bulk-order account pulls its whole history into memory in one request. Fix: `LIMIT`/`OFFSET`
citations.S14: Positional tuple indices couple three functions invisibly — medium.** `o[1]` and `order[0]` silently break if the `SELECT` column order changes
